_about: Sessellift G8, an eight-seat gondola cabin (task 4.24) on the Sessellift D6's terminals and wide heads: only the carrier is new. Millimetres, chair frame: u = travel, v = outboard (the door and hanger side), w = up, origin the grip on the rope. Measured on the owner's reference cabin (kept locally, never in the repo; Gate 0, 2026-11-17). The D6 hangs its rope 3,600 over the load level, so the cabin hangs 500 higher than the reference (owner, Gate 0): its floor sits 135 over the load level. The cabin hangs centred under the haul rope (centreV 0, owner): the hanger runs outboard round the stations, then back in to a clamp over the roof's middle.

common._about: The D6's line (sessellift_d6.json common): the cabin runs on its terminals and heads.

cabin._profile: the barrel's plan section at each height: [w, half along u, half across v]; a rounded rectangle of corner radius cornerR, fitted within 3 to the reference's measured silhouette (every 20); profileFar (LOD1), profileMid (LOD2) and profileSpeck (LOD3) pick levels from it, each keeping the glass edges

pillar._about: the corners are the livery shell itself (the reference paints its corner arcs red): the arc and a strip this wide either side of it

door._about: two leaves on the outboard face, shut (no door motion): livery frames (outer and inner stiles, top and bottom rails) and a black seal where the leaves meet

skiRack._about: on each door leaf: a basket for the ski tails and three bars the skis lean on

basket._about: a box tipped out at the top by tilt (degrees), from its inner bottom edge origin [v, w]: out and height in its own frame, the outer corners rounded in plan, a dark rim round the open top

bar._about: a flat strap standing off the door on two short legs at its ends

bumpers._about: black rubber pads on the end faces at the corners, rounded every way

skid._about: the guide tube under the inboard side: bowed out past the floor, its ends hooked back in under it; path [u, v] is the centreline's +u half (mirrored); it hangs drop under the underside (Gate 0: the reference's 70 would reach under the load level)

bench._about: two benches of four across the line, facing each other

roofFrame._about: the hanger's frame on the roof: two bars along u on four black mounts (a knob [dia, height] on top of each), two channels across them (the spine) at the same height, a fork of two plates clasping the hanger's arm, joined over it by two crossbars

hanger._about: the D6 hanger from the grip's socket down and outboard round the stations' bellies (proven clear there), then a broad elbow into a level arm over the roof, clasped by the roof frame's fork; a square bar like the reference's, a little stouter (owner: in proportion with the cabin)

step._about: the dark step plate under the doors

handrail._about: a dark handrail inside on the inboard wall
